title: Model lists stop serving stale responses
summary:
Model lists shed stale cache responses, the community showcase got a tidy-up, and API examples became easier to follow.

Requests to `/openai/models` now bypass the cache, so OpenAI-compatible model lists can reflect changes such as qwen-reasoning and phi-mini without waiting for a cached response to expire.

Riffle, an app that weaves vocabulary practice into English reading, was added to the Creative Apps listings. The TeekGenAI listing was removed; the image API and external app were not changed.

The API docs gained clearer audio, vision, and request-body examples. Version 1.0.6 of `@pollinations/model-context-protocol` adds compatibility for Node.js versions below 16 and declares support for Node.js 14+.
